items.source: When CompositeRequestCondition instances are combined or compared is expected that (a) they contain the same number of conditions and (b) conditions at the same index are of the same type. It is acceptable to provide null conditions or no conditions at all to the constructor.
items.translation: 当组合或比较 `CompositeRequestCondition` 实例时，预期它们 (a) 包含相同数量的条件，且 (b) 相同索引处的条件类型相同。向构造函数提供 `null` 条件或完全不提供条件是允许的。

items.source: An empty CompositeRequestCondition matches to all requests.
items.translation: 空CompositeRequestCondition匹配所有请求。

items.source:
If both instances have conditions, combine the individual conditions
after ensuring they are of the same type and number.
items.translation: 如果两个实例都包含条件，请在确保它们类型和数量相同后，合并各个条件。

items.source: Create an instance with 0 or more RequestCondition types. It is important to create CompositeRequestCondition instances with the same number of conditions so they may be compared and combined. It is acceptable to provide null conditions.
items.translation: 创建一个包含 0 个或多个RequestCondition类型的实例。创建CompositeRequestCondition实例时，重要的是要确保条件数量相同，以便进行比较和组合。提供null条件是允许的。

items.source: Return the underlying conditions, possibly empty but never null.
items.translation: 返回底层条件，可能为空但绝不null。

items.source: Whether this instance contains 0 conditions or not.
items.translation: 无论此实例是否包含 0 个条件。

items.source:
If one instance is empty, the other "wins". If both instances have
conditions, compare them in the order in which they were provided.
items.translation: 如果一个实例为空，则另一个“胜出”。如果两个实例都包含条件，则按照它们提供的顺序进行比较。
